subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should maintainers proceed with the read-only mobile workspace browser now, and if so which open PR path should become canonical?
rationale: The feature is useful and partially unblocked by the merged Gateway RPC, but mobile arbitrary workspace reads and share/export are security-sensitive and the issue is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Finish Stacked Read-Only Mobile PRs
options.body: Use the merged Gateway read RPC as the base and complete the focused iOS and Android PRs with platform proof and security review.

options.title: Adopt One End-To-End PR
options.body: Choose the contributor end-to-end PR or a replacement branch as the single landing path, then close or redirect the stacked mobile PRs.

options.title: Defer To Full Workspace API
options.body: Pause the mobile browser until the broader workspace-management API and CRUD security model are settled.

recommendation.title: Finish Stacked Read-Only Mobile PRs
recommendation.body: Use the merged Gateway read RPC as the base and complete the focused iOS and Android PRs with platform proof and security review.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the protected issue context and authored the merged Gateway slice plus the stacked mobile implementation PRs.
